questions.expected_answer: The data source refused the connection because the Kestrel IP addresses are not on its allowlist. Add both 203.0.113.10 and 203.0.113.11; adding only one causes intermittent errors.

questions.question: A user gets KST-4012 when accepting an invitation. What should support tell them?
questions.expected_answer: There is no free seat. An Admin must free a seat, or the Owner must add seats or upgrade. The same invitation then works if it is less than 7 days old.
questions.model_answer: The KST-4012 error typically indicates that the user's invitation token has expired or has already been used, and support should advise them to request a new invitation link from their administrator.

questions.question: I lost my phone and I can't log in anymore. What can I do?
questions.expected_answer: Use a backup code. Without one, ask a workspace Admin to reset your second factor. If you are the only Admin or the Owner, contact support from the account's e-mail address; identity verification can take up to 2 business days.
